mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS shows a sustained decline over 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a month but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such cases, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader demand contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both RSAFS and HOUST decline in the same month but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such months, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0, the manufacturing sector slowdown signals reduced corporate earnings growth potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential investment (RSAFS) trend over the past 3 months indicates strengthening household demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS shows a sustained rise over 3 months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of such periods, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y/y exceeds 2.5% but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such months, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a labor market contraction, which signals weakening consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such months, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the monetary policy is restrictive, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such periods, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.
